items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I played with him down at the Lighthouse a couple of times. Because Howard hired me for one night or two nights, and then I sat in with them before that.

ctx.x: A wonderful little room. And the guy was fantastic. He never made a lot of money. If he ran out of booze he’d send somebody down to the drug store and pick it up and bring it back. But anyway Shorty came in that night and said, “How would you like to join the Giants?” I said, “Well great,” I said, because I played with him down at the Lighthouse a couple of times. Because Howard hired me for one night or two nights, and then I sat in with them before that. He said, “Well we’re going to be going on a tour in…
What kind of money was he offering back then for that kind of gig?
